The '''Daplona base training center''' was a base located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ciutric IV]].

It was here where the [[Ysanne Isard (clone)|clone]] of [[Ysanne Isard]], the former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]], hid while letting [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] believe she was piloting the [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttle]] he was chasing.

Antilles was not fooled however. After shooting down the shuttle, he used the scans of the shuttle's comm frequencies to triangulate her location from which she was directing the [[Lorrir/Legends|pilot]] of the shuttle. Antilles let loose a pair of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] which destroyed the building and effectively [[Death/Legends|killed]]  the clone.
